name: Amory Vivian
original_name: อโมรี่ วิเวียน
source:
Etymology: Amory = Leader | Vivian = Full of Life
Age: 16
Nationality: Rosetanian
Role: Grade 10 Student / Roommate
Personality: With her stoic expression and sharp eyes, Vivian is often mistaken for being stern. In reality, she is simply quiet—unless the topic is sweets, about which she can talk endlessly. She hides her passion for desserts to maintain her 'cool' image. Deep down, she longs for acceptance and shows a hidden warmth through awkward but sincere attempts at friendship.

[From in-game profile]
